response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, CAST(SUM(t.amount) AS REAL) / SUM(SUM(t.amount)) OVER () AS fraction FROM account a JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10;
